assessment.text_and_structure: Comparable on this six-page example: OvisOCR2 produced 27 headings, 3992 words, and approximately 95.98% MinerU-token recall with 92.05% normalized token-sequence similarity.
assessment.tables: Comparable: both produced four tables; parsed row and cell counts match, and tables 2-4 have exact normalized cell sequences.
assessment.formulas_and_statistics: Comparable after notation normalization: plus-minus and kappa values are preserved, with different LaTeX/rendered notation.
assessment.visual_assets_and_provenance: MinerU is stronger in this pipeline because it preserves one flowchart drawing asset, bbox anchors, block IDs, and asset metadata. The local Ovis runner removes optional image tags and does not save crops.
assessment.limitations: This is a one-document engineering comparison, not a human-annotated accuracy benchmark. It should not be generalized to all layouts or languages.
